description_full:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING: KOL SPECIALIST INTERN!

Ready to kickstart your career in the influencer marketing industry? 👀✨

LICO MEDIA is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic KOL Specialist Intern to join our growing team!

If you're interested in KOL management, influencer marketing, and TikTok Shop Affiliate, this might be the opportunity you've been waiting for!

📍 Placement: Tanjung Duren, West Jakarta 🏢 Work Arrangement: 100% Work From Office (WFO) ⚡ Availability: Able to join ASAP

📩 Interested? Apply now!

Send your updated CV to licomediaindonesia@gmail.com with the subject: KOL Specialist Intern – Your Name

Or simply scan the QR code on the poster to apply!

Tag someone who might be interested and don't miss this opportunity. Let's grow together with LICO MEDIA! ❤️

[poster text]
LICO

INTERN
REQUIREMENTS :
• Fresh graduates or active university
students from Marketing, Communication,
Business, or related fields.

• Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and basic
creator sourcing.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel / Google
Sheets.
Good communication, organizational, and
administrative skills.
Detail-oriented, proactive, eager to learn,
and comfortable working in a fast-paced
environment.
Social media or influencer-related
experience is a plus.
APPLY NOW
licomediaindonesia@gmail.com
